description:
Only for a diagram the user explicitly asked to get fast or cheap: a quick, fast or rough diagram, a sketch or a draft, little effort or few tokens, in any language ("schnell", "Skizze", "wenig Aufwand", "sparsam"). A request without such words, however simple the diagram, goes to create_diagram, never here, and so do the types not listed here: create_diagram places the shapes with more care. A change to a diagram drawn here comes back here.

Creates and displays a draw.io diagram from a description of its content: you say what exists and how it connects, the server lays it out, routes the lines and styles it. Never give coordinates, sizes or styles. To change the diagram, call this again with the whole changed description, keeping the ids, the cells of what stays and the layout.

Arguments: type, title, nodes, edges, groups; their keys are in the schema.

type "flowchart" (processes, with or without swimlanes): nodes are steps with a kind (start, end, step, decision, error, data); for swimlanes, groups are the lanes in order and each node names its lane in group; edges are transitions, labeled on the branches of a decision ("Yes", "No"). End every path at an end node.

Placement: give every node row and col, its cell in one grid for the whole diagram: at most 6 cols, a large diagram grows down, to 8 rows. A group's nodes form a block of cells of their own, which the server frames. A lane is a row (or a column) of that grid, col (or row) the step.

from.description: id of a node or group

to.description: id of a node or group

parent.description: id of the group this one is nested in

layout.description: On every change of a diagram: the layout of its last result, copied exactly, also when you add, move or renumber cells. What keeps its cell then stays in place and only what the change needs room for moves; without it, every shape can move

col.description: The column of the node's cell (1 is the left) in that grid. At most 6: every further column makes all the text smaller (the steps of a lane diagram may need more). The nodes of a group form a block of cells with no other node in it, nested groups a block in their parent's. With lanes as rows, col is the step of the flow over all lanes: a step that hands over to another lane can keep the col of the step before it, straight below or above

group.description: id of the group or lane the node is in

id.description: Unique, kept when the diagram is changed

kind.description: flowchart: start, end, step, decision, error, data

row.description: The row of the node's cell (1 is the top) in one grid for the whole diagram, not per group. Up to 8 rows are shown whole: a diagram that needs more cells than 6 × 6 gets more rows, not more columns. With lanes as rows, every lane has a row to itself (two when its steps branch)

sub.description: Optional second line in small text (a technology, an address)

title.description: A title shown above the diagram.

name: create_semantic_diagram
title: Create Diagram from a Description
